title: Dataset
description: The wire form of one datasets row (0006_evidence.up.sql section 2): chapter 7 section 7.3.1's Dataset. Item type of table 10.2-B row 32. ONE Dataset IS ONE SOURCE AND ONE LICENCE, which is why row R26's seal names an existing one and does not create it: `custodian` is chapter 7's source_id, is carried verbatim into every manifest and exported bundle, and is the issuer fallback of MOS-EVID-010 when IssuerOfPatientID is absent -- so two collections sharing one row would share a patient-key space they do not share in reality. MOS-EVID-027 makes the licence travel with the exported bundle, and recording it is a legal act by the site on the same footing as the TrainingDataPolicy of MOS-TRAIN-073 that MOS-UI-110 keeps off the no-code surface. Row 33 (POST /datasets) is deliberately NOT declared in medos/api/v1/routes.{core,train}.yaml: it binds `dataset.write`, which section 8.3.2 registers as a spelling a build MUST fail on and which MOS-UI-104 forbids this surface propagating; re-pointing it is chapter 10's edit under register entry 5, and minting a parallel path so that the console could dodge the question would be a second answer to it.

purpose.description: MOS-EVID-026 is normative for this five-value set. It matters on the seal path: MOS-EVID-082 forbids an acceptance binding naming a DatasetVersion whose purpose is `training` or `tuning`, and MOS-UI-146 requires the console to check that at seal because discovering at evaluation time that no bar exists wastes the entire run.

custodian.description: Chapter 7's source_id -- `TCIA/LIDC-IDRI`, `site-a/pacs`. Never empty: an empty issuer silently merges two collections' patient keys (MOS-EVID-010). It is a source identifier and not an institution name, so MOS-EVID-116 and MOS-UI-113 are not engaged by rendering it.

licence_spdx.description: MOS-EVID-027: non-null together with licence_text for any visibility other than tenant_private, enforced by datasets_licence_required. Null on a private dataset and null is not `no licence`.
